title: CSWAP: Real World Asset Expansion - Real Value for Cardano

ms.promise: We will provide a detailed business requirements document. This document will outline exactly what is needed from a business perspective to deliver a complete solution for our RWA expansion. The business requirements document will include all aspects included in the acceptance criteria.
ms.criteria:
The business requirements document must describe the requirements in a way so that the team can begin the solution design process.
・Key Stakeholder Requirements: Determine which business processes must be automated/facilitated by the proposed solution from the lens of each user role in the system. e.g. Third party vendor, CSWAP team, retail consumer...etc

・Scope of Work: Determine the scope of solution based on the key stakeholder requirements. The scope of work must fulfill the key stakeholder requirements. Functional/non-functional requirements will be provided in the screen design document
ms.report:
The Business Requirements Document (BRD) has been completed in alignment with the defined outputs, acceptance criteria, and evidence requirements for milestone completion. It has been reviewed and formally approved by CSWAP leadership.
The finalized BRD is attached as a PDF via Google Drive.
Link to PDF: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1v2mSJ_Z-cHn2M9GLIdHp7EJmzeXGEOzS/view?usp=sharing

ms.promise: We will provide a working screen design document with wireframes and functional description for each screen/module. Since we are an AGILE team, the document will be a working document, meaning it is subject to change throughout the development process.
ms.criteria:
The screen design document will include the following:
・An outline detailing the non-functional requirements of the proposed solution. e.g. usability, security, scalability etc.
・Screen designs, wireframes, or mockups of each screen or module required to deliver a solution that fulfills the business requirements. The scope of design can not be determined until milestone 1 has been completed.
・Functional requirements: The functional requirements will be provided alongside the design elements to ensure that the solution meets all business requirements. e.g. user clicks a button to start the nft

ms.promise:
There will be multiple outputs for the RWA Minting Functionality milestone (which includes proprietary front end code which can be shared with the catalyst reviewers (but not the public) via git repo access):
・Front end code and plutus scripts or smart contracts
・Scripts which enable the creation of certificates and or reference documents to be incorporated within NFT RWAs
・On-chain evidence of minting of RWAs and the actual tokenized RWAs themselves (asset names, tx ids)
・A public facing tool (pre-prod) that will allow a third-party to tokenize an RWA from at least two different asset type categories e.g. collectible & commodity
・A screen share of using the tool to facilitate review of the preliminary RWA minting solution
ms.criteria:
1. Front-End Code and Plutus Scripts
The submitted code enables the minting of tokenized RWAs, adhering to the outlined functional requirements.
Scripts are complete, deployable, and meet technical specifications for minting RWAs.
2. Certificate and Reference Document Integration
The scripts successfully embed of certificates or reference documents within tokenized RWAs. For example, the certificates (as part of the RWAs) will be verifiable on-chain on cexplorer.io and/or cardanoscan.io.
3. Successful minting of RWAs 
The minting process successfully supports at least two asset type categories
